prompts: A client loves the woodblock print attached, also in {WS}/print.jpg; it is in the public domain. They want a 3D wallpaper that copies it: its composition, its palette and its subjects, so anyone who knows the print recognizes it at a glance, rebuilt as our own low poly scene with some gentle motion. Deliver {WS}/scene/index.html, a single file with everything built in code: the print is the reference, not a texture. Record in {WS}/result.json what you took from it: boats (how many the print shows) and mountain (its name). It is reviewed by opening the file, with no build step, in a browser that reaches only Google Fonts and https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.170.0/build/three.module.js.
answers:
[goal] Rebuild Hokusai's *Under the Wave off Kanagawa* as a single-file, low-poly Three.js wallpaper, plus record the reference facts.

[action] Inspected `./print.jpg` visually, then built `./scene/index.html`: an extruded, vertex-coloured great wave with foam claws and a curling tip, a smaller right-hand swell, three oshiokuri-bune with rowers and oars, a low-poly Fuji with snow cap, cream/Prussian-blue palette, seigaiha-free layered swells, a drawn kanji-style cartouche, spray particles, and gentle bob/sway/parallax motion. Rendered the page in a browser at 1280×800 and iterated twice on silhouette, Fuji scale, boat shape and foam placement. Wrote `./result.json`.

[result] Delivered. Verified by opening `http://localhost:8123/index.html` in the browser and reading the rendered screenshot (no build step; only import is `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.170.0/build/three.module.js`; no image is used as a texture — grep for `print.jpg` in the scene returns 0). `result.json` parses as valid JSON and states **3 boats** and **Mount Fuji**; the print shows three boats (one on the left crest, one under Fuji, one large in the foreground) and the small snow-capped peak at centre-right is Fuji, the subject of the series title in the cartouche. Visible choices left open by the brief: 9-segment faceted Fuji, stylised brush-mark cartouche instead of real kanji (avoids font/tofu risk), full-bleed wallpaper framing rather than print borders, and continuous ambient motion rather than a scrolling animation.

[next] None. Scratch server on port 8123 stopped by its PID.
